text:
People Ops: Quick update — we’re piloting a voluntary “Summer Wellbeing Week” the week of 2024-07-22. Office will operate on reduced staffing that week. Options for folks: 1) Use 5 PTO days, 2) Swap 5 flex/wellness days (if you have them), or 3) Take 3 PTO + request up to 2 unpaid days. We’re also offering a short-term caregiving stipend ($200/day capped at 3 days) for anyone covering childcare/eldercare that week. Please fill the form by 2024-06-30: https://intranet.redwood/wellbeing-form :sun_with_face:

Jon H: Appreciate the forward notice. Is approval required from managers for the stipend?

People Ops: Good Q — yes, manager sign-off is required so we can plan coverage. The form has a manager approval checkbox. No payroll action needed beyond our internal workflow; People Ops will handle payments.

Lina M: If I don’t have enough flex days can I convert misc comp time?

People Ops: We’ll allow one-time conversion of up to 2 comp hours into a partial day of PTO for this pilot — file the request in the form and your manager will confirm.

Marco R: Will this count against my vacation accrual/reporting for the year?

People Ops: Yes — PTO used counts against your annual balance. The swap option keeps your accrual intact (we deduct from your flex/wellness bucket instead). We’ll update MyTime reports automatically.

Devon: Is travel coverage/expense allowed if I need to travel for caregiving that week?

People Ops: Travel for caregiving is eligible for expense reimbursement only if previously preapproved. Quick path: mark the travel on the form and your manager + Finance will review.

OpsBot: Form submitted: 1745000123 by Lina M (manager sign-off pending).

Lina M: Thanks — submitted.

People Ops: Heads up on two policies tied to the pilot: 1) No mandatory on-call obligations during the reduced week unless explicitly scheduled; 2) Code of conduct still in effect for any company-sponsored gatherings. Please be mindful of accessibility and inclusive behavior if teams plan small in-person meetups.

Elena (CEO): Love this idea. Team — please coordinate with your managers and be respectful of coverage needs. :sparkles:

Jon H: One last thing — will there be blackout dates for product launches or SRE rotations?

People Ops: We’ll publish a brief coverage roster by 2024-07-05 with any blackout windows (critical launches, major incident windows). If your team expects a launch, set it on the form and we’ll coordinate alternatives (canary staffing, cross-team coverage).

Marco R: Cool. Thanks People Ops!

People Ops: Thanks all — filing FAQ & updated policy doc here: https://intranet.redwood/policies/wellbeing-week (will post update to Calendar and send a reminder 2 weeks before). :calendar:

[thread closed by People Ops]
